name: hypotrail-companion
description: A study panel for a Hypotrail study: recap, plan position, deliverables, open proposals and holds. Its only write is confirming or withdrawing an open proposal through the hypotrail CLI, with the junior's own typed words. Off by default.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The companion runs the study's hypotrail CLI, recorded in .hypotrail/agent.json.

hypotrail.companion.enabled.description: Enable the Hypotrail study panel (v0, experimental). Off by default; the environment variable HYPOTRAIL_COMPANION=1 also enables it.
